## Botanical Garden of the Piedmont Commercial Sponsored by VNB


Virginia National Bank supports our local communities and recognizes the important programs and preserved outdoor space provided by the **[Botanical Garden of the Piedmont](https://piedmontgarden.org/)** .


Their mission is to welcome all community members and visitors to engage in nature, to inspire learning through the beauty and importance of plants, to advance sustainability, and to promote human and environmental well-being.
